title: System Preparation and Equilibration
action: For each ε_norm in {0.5,0.75,1.0,1.25,1.5,1.75,2.0,5.0,10.0}, build an amorphous polycarbonate cell (9902 atoms) with DREIDING LJ ε scaled by ε_norm. Run a six-stage equilibration (minimize, NVT 500K, NPT 500K 0atm, cool to 300K 0atm, NVT 300K, NPT 300K 0atm) in LAMMPS.
description: Equilibrated configurations and a summary CSV recording final density and total energy for each ε_norm.

title: Density Extraction
action: From the final NPT configuration at 300 K for each ε_norm, compute mass density (total mass / volume).
description: Density of the amorphous polycarbonate as a function of normalized Lennard-Jones ε.
output_schema: Columns: epsilon_norm (float), density_g_cm3 (float). One row per ε_norm.

title: Tensile Simulation and Young's Modulus Calculation
action: For each ε_norm, perform uniaxial tensile deformation along X, Y, Z at 300 K (NPT, zero transverse pressure, strain rate 1e8 s⁻¹ to 2% strain). Record stress-strain data. Fit linear slope (0–2%) to obtain modulus; average over the three directions. Output a JSON with raw arrays and a CSV with the averaged modulus.
description: Averaged Young's modulus (over X, Y, Z directions) for each normalized Lennard-Jones ε.
output_schema: Columns: epsilon_norm (float), young_modulus_GPa (float). One row per ε_norm.
